summary: Iter 30 focused RETEST of scroll-to-bottom FAB on /chats/user_3ce097eea931. The fix (wrapper style changed from minHeight:100vh → height:100dvh on line 276 of ChatRoomPage.jsx, plus removal of redundant minHeight:60vh on the message list) is VERIFIED WORKING. All 4 requested checks pass: (1) .overflow-y-auto is now internally scrollable — scrollHeight=3400 > clientHeight=724, body height=windowH=844 (no page-body scroll). (2) After sending 6 long padding messages and scrolling the list up ~200px, data-testid='scroll-to-bottom' FAB appears with an SVG chevron-down icon. (3) Clicking the FAB smooth-scrolls the list back to bottom (atBottom=true, scrollTop=2676 = scrollHeight-clientHeight) AND the FAB unmounts within 700ms. (4) No visual regression — header is position:sticky, attach-tray opens on btn-plus and closes on tray-close as before. Iter-29 FAB blocker is fully resolved; entire iter-29 feature set is now green.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: `height:'100dvh'` on the max-w-md flex-col wrapper properly constrains the flex-1 message list, letting overflow-y-auto handle internal scroll. 100dvh (vs 100vh) is the right choice for iOS dynamic viewport / Safari safe-area handling.

Removing the redundant `minHeight:'60vh'` on the message list was also correct — with the parent now height-bounded, flex-1 alone is sufficient and any min-height would re-introduce the old overflow-past-parent behavior.

rca of the issue: Previous iter-29 FAB failure RCA: wrapper used min-height:100vh (no upper bound), so flex-1 message list grew past viewport and body scrolled instead of the container — the onScroll handler on `.overflow-y-auto` never fired. Fix applied by main agent in iter-30: replaced with height:100dvh (fixed upper bound + iOS-safe). Verified: scrollHeight now correctly > clientHeight, onScroll fires, showScrollDown state toggles, FAB mounts/unmounts as designed.
